en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a landscaped park with a path leading to a tall, multi-storey clock or bell tower with a domed roof and lantern topped by a finial. Trees surround the tower, and there is a pavilion or kiosk on the right with chairs or benches arranged outdoors. A man in a suit and hat stands on the path in the foreground. Handwritten text appears along the bottom margin.
